blank_fields.Withdrawal Velocity (mm/s): Measured withdrawal speed; velocity smoothness and LLD. Must vary for velocity smoothness.
blank_fields.Viscosity (cP): Validated solution viscosity at the relevant concentration and temperature; LLD.
blank_fields.Surface Tension (mN/m): Validated solution surface tension at the relevant conditions; LLD.
blank_fields.Wet-to-Dry Mobile Factor: Dimensionless independently justified wet-to-dry conversion in (0,1]; LLD. Never derive from target thickness.
blank_fields.LLD Applicable: Explicit lab-validated 0/1 regime flag; blank means unknown, not zero.
blank_fields.Experiment ID: Actual experimental unit identifier, if recoverable; do not invent synthetic parent IDs.
blank_fields.measurement_source: Source/citation or measurement identifier for supplied physics values.
blank_fields.unit_confirmation: Record checked units and applicable measurement conditions.
blank_fields.regime_evidence: Evidence for geometry, rheology, wetting, evaporation and low-capillary-number applicability.
